# ScalableSNNTraining

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A training paradigm that allows spiking neural networks to be trained efficiently on large-scale datasets without the computational bottlenecks of traditional spike-based learning rules. This is critical for deploying SNNs in real-world applications, as it overcomes the scalability limitations that have hindered neuromorphic systems.
